definitions.order_parameter: pump-x complex half-pump displacement amplitude; accepted NiH force/loss and dt unchanged
definitions.C_phase: sum_i m_i m_(i+d) conj(z_i)z_(i+d)/P_phase(d), z=A/abs(A) only at exactly nonzero occupied amplitudes
definitions.normalization: Actual integer occupied-pair counts; undefined displacements are not zero-filled and no amplitude/ratio floor is introduced. A phase of a dying seed is not a sustained state.
definitions.full_vs_connected: Raw C and Gamma coherent fraction are preserved; Gamma-centered amplitude C is a separate diagnostic and no short connected xi is substituted for a raw plateau.
definitions.carrier: All raw/directional curves remain; carrier-removed C uses the actually dominant finite-q amplitude mode.
definitions.integral_scale: Vq=v_site*sum_d C_phase(d)*exp(-iq_carrier.d); xi_int=(Vq/(8pi))^(1/3), an integral convention, not an exponential fit or a domain radius. Full finite-box plateau is included.
definitions.time_windows: Long lock-in C and temporal means of equal-time16-cycle cosine/sine/DC least-squares envelopes are distinct.
definitions.boundaries: Reference layer-adapted FCC, bulk periodic; radial plots restricted to the inscribed box and all9 directional curves retained.
definitions.phase_picture: Raw pi alternation of a finite-q standing pattern is not automatically a defect wall; Gaussian carrier-envelope smoothing is visualization only, not used in C or xi.

loss_result: entry_654; all measured homogeneous losses unknown; no baseline loss recalibration
